notes.title: Update version 1.709.11 is available
notes.notes:
Dear friends! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/48e4a7e4d3182ec77545ddfaed6f44bae49a0f96.jpg[/img]

Foremost we would like to thank all our friends in Steam, everybody, who has played our game, who helped us to make it better and posted some comments and recommendations. It’s really REALLY important to us, as we are working on our first project!

Based on the first week after the release feedback and results, we are launching the first official update of [b]Star Story: The Horizon Escape[/b] and introduce v.1.709.11!

What’s new:
[list]
[*]A large update to English and Russian localisation files. Typos, stylistics, grammar - all got a big fix.
[*]A major bug in the ending scene (the game could freeze) identified and fixed.
[*]Weapons reload interface improved for better usability.
[/list]
Sincerely yours,
EvilCoGamesTeam

notes.title: The full release of Star Story: The Horizon Escape
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/8c948ccbe355211b0d49e67d21c880c7dfad90aa.png[/img]
Dear friends! Evil Corporation Games studio presents the fully complete, revised and improved version of the game Star Story: The Horizon Escape out of early access!!!

Work on this game lasted 1 year. Since the release of the alpha version on April 14, 2017 in the early access Star Story: The Horizon Escape took the first prize in the nomination «Best PC game»  according to Indie Cup 2017 and got the first place in the Deconstruction Workshop at the White Nights St. Petersburg 2017 conference.

Sincerely, we hope that when you play our game, you will have as much fun as we got while we were developing it. 

So, meet Star Story: The Horizon Escape

Best regards,
EvilCoGames team

notes.title: ✧The final countdown to full release \ (•◡•) /
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/1c9a588cc8add75ce5d6eb72e101fd7b09960e58.jpg[/img]
Dear friends! 
It has been a long time since we released the [b]Star Story: The Horizon Escape on Steam[/b].
We are ready to announce the exact release date of the fully complete, revised and improved (from standpoint, at least :) version of the game, out of early access.
It will be available to all players on Steam on [b]September 5, 2017[/b]!
Working on the update, we carefully considered all the comments and suggestions that we received.
[list]
    [*]We put great emphasis on the extension of the content in the game. We have revamped the world of Horizon, deepened character backgrounds and completely rewritten the story, while staying true to the original motives - now it's non-linear and have 24 (!!!!) alternative endings.
    [*]For the new version, many new worlds were created by our artists, the graphics of existing locations were detailed and extended with new unique events.
    [*]The event generation system was rebuilt by our dev. team to provide much more varied gameplay. Now it’s much less predictable and obvious than in the early access version.
[/list]
In a word, our team has invested a lot of work, love and desire to finish the complete version of the project, which we called Star Story: The Horizon Escape!
Sincerely, we hope that when you play our game, you will have as much fun as we got while we were developing it. 
 ✧ So, do not forget, on September 5th - the full release of Star Story: The Horizon Escape! ✧

notes.title: Nearest game update. Work is in full swing!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Four months have passed since we presented the [b]Star Story: the Horizon Escape [/b] in early access. 
[b]The Evil Corporation Games[/b]’ team would like to thank all, who have expressed support for our project and especially those who have shared their opinion and comments. 
Having carefully considered all proposals and wishes of the gamers as well as professional comments of our colleagues, we continued further developing and finishing up the game, and hope to full release early next month.
One of the major components of a good game is the storyline. To lift a veil a little, we can say that it has become much longer, comprising over 20 alternative finals.  What concretely awaits the main character Van Klik at the end of his attempts to flee from the Planet Horizon depends exclusively on the individual choice of behavior in different situations offered by the game.  Every next time you may play differently choosing new options to develop the plot.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/df0162201fb57bf9dd1730b017478be630a3d584.jpg[/img]

The artists of the Evil Corporation Games have considerably widened the spaces of the Horizon by creating new locations and filling the backgrounds of the initial version of the game with many new details.
However, we would rather not to reveal our insights and groundworks all at once, but invite you to follow our news!

Yours respectfully,
EvilCoGames.

notes.title: Mac version&more
notes.notes:
So…

The [b]Mac version[/b] of Star Story: The Horizon Escape is here! 

This version is also available in Early Access, just like the Win PC one. And don’t worry, we’re regularly checking the game for bugs and errors. 
Mac-users, we hope you’ll enjoy the game!

P.S. We'll also prepare the Linux version near future. 
Stay tuned!
